name: fortinet-api-conventions
description: FortiManager JSON-RPC and FortiOS REST conventions and traps: api-key Bearer auth and why /sys/logout must never be called, RPC fault classes and retry policy, proxy vs direct device transport, /dvmdb rosters and HA serial flips, CMDB vs monitor reads, access-profile groups (system/global needs System, not Network), the admission-vs-connectivity split on the managed-switch and managed-AP tables (and the firmware variance in the AP's status vocabulary), DHCP reservation/lease/VIP shapes, quarantine address groups, FortiSwitch and FortiAP SNMP quirks, and the FortiSwitch / FortiAP local web-UI firmware-upgrade protocol (login forms, image header token = serial prefix, upload field order, compat check, deploy, reboot wait).
